newsitem.title: FRANCE: French chill kills 30 over two weeks.
newsitem.headline: French chill kills 30 over two weeks.

text.p: Arctic weather has claimed three more victims in France, pushing to about 30 the death toll over a sub-zero fortnight, police said on Tuesday.
The body of a homeless Moroccan was found outside a baker's shop near Melun, east of Paris. Police said the 45-year-old man had turned down social services offers to take him to a shelter.
An 81-year-old woman missing since Saturday was found dead in snow near her home in the Ardeche region.

Police found the body of a 41-year-old woman under a bridge in the nearby Drome area. They said she was being treated in a psychiatric hospital and had failed to return after spending Christmas with relatives.

Arctic weather has hit many areas of Europe since Christmas. Weather services said a thaw would set in from the south in the next few days, but bitter cold would last until the weekend in the northeast of the country.
